title: .respawnpack/runtime/index-lease-<sha16>.json — exclusive ownership of one git index
description: Written by hooks/_index-lease.js acquire()/confirm(). GITIGNORED. Keyed on the INDEX IDENTITY (the absolute, forward-slashed, lowercased path of the git index), not on the project directory, so two principals aimed at one linked worktree contend correctly. ⛔ AN UNREADABLE RECORD IS NOT AN ABSENT ONE: readLease() distinguishes null from {error}, because a corrupt lease that read as 'nobody holds this index' would hand it to a second writer. ⛔ AND A LEASE IS TAKEN PROVISIONALLY: a PreToolUse hook cannot know what a later hook will decide, so PostToolUse confirms — otherwise a call that was denied downstream wedged the index for the full TTL.

reclaimedFrom.description: Present only when a stale lease was taken over. A reclaim is always RECORDED — an aggressive expiry that hands the index to a second writer while the first is still working is the corruption the lease exists to prevent.
